The cost-benefit analysis failed due to incorrect margin calculations and total annual margin discrepancies in the output data.
The verifier failed in test_rows_and_order with 'close(302.4, 4536.0)' returning False, indicating a significant error in program-level financial metrics. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with 'close(-61983.9, -79751.7)', showing the aggregated 10-day USD annual margin does not match expected values. The execution environment successfully ran the pytest suite at /tests/test_outputs.py but recorded a 0.00 reward due to these assertion failures.
